exposure: cesarean delivery due to maternal request
outcome: Individual components of composite neonatal and maternal morbidity
finding: Cesarean delivery by maternal choice in NTSV patients is not associated with improved neonatal outcomes but is associated with increased composite maternal morbidity and increased transfusion rate.
mod_finding: Patients who chose cesarean delivery during the intrapartum period had a higher (but not statistically significant) composite neonatal morbidity and composite maternal morbidity and significantly higher transfusion rate.
